## Code Review Findings Summary

### Standards Axis
- **Conventions & Architecture**: Conforms to `AGENTS.md` and deep module principles. English documentation and clean test structure.
- **Repository Verification**:
  - `npm run type-check`: 0 errors.
  - `npm test`: 23 test suites, 223 tests passed.
  - `npm run test:evals`: 3 test suites, 26 tests passed.
  - `npm run build`: Clean ESM build (`dist/index.js`).
- **Smell Baseline**: 0 violations detected. Clean modular decomposition in `daemon-keys.ts` (`formatDaemonStatusLine`, `getRotatingTipIndex`, `getRotatingTip`) and ANSI-safe rendering primitives in `terminal-card.ts` (`truncateAnsi`).

### Spec Axis (Issue #90)
- **Status**: 100% compliant with deliverables.
  - Added smooth 4-second cycling through all 11 keybinding tips in the foreground daemon idle status line (`DAEMON_STATUS_TIPS`).
  - Added paused state UX displaying `PAUSED` indicator and resume tips (`DAEMON_PAUSED_TIPS`).
  - Added narrow terminal viewport width guardrails using ANSI-aware truncation (`truncateAnsi`), clamping ticker lines to `columns - 2` and omitting tips when columns < 55 to prevent line wrapping or scrolling artifacts.
  - Added 8 new unit tests in `tests/daemon-keys.test.ts` (38 total in the suite) and 2 new tests in `tests/terminal-card.test.ts` (25 total in the suite) covering rotating tips, paused mode, narrow terminal bounds, and ANSI truncation.
  - Updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased] - 2026-09-09`.

### Security Pass
- Zero hardcoded secrets or credentials.
- ANSI escape code safety in `truncateAnsi`: handles escape sequences without corruption, resets trailing formatting `\x1b[0m`, and prevents terminal state desynchronization.
